counties.notes: RETIRED 2026-10-18, with the reason: Greenville County has removed every public map service from www.gcgis.org (checked 2026-10-18: the services root lists only a Utilities folder and no services, and the registered Tax Parcel layer, GreenvilleJS/Map_Layers_JS/MapServer/52, answers 'Service not found'), and it sells its parcel data instead. The county's GIS Division sells 'Tax Parcels & Ownership Information' as countywide vector data on a USB flash drive, $500 in shapefile format, under a data order form and release agreement (www.gcgis.org/AccessDistribution.html). The rebuilt county viewer (www.gcgis.org/apps/greenvillenj/) runs on a private ASP.NET web API that is not an ArcGIS REST service. No South Carolina statewide parcel layer carries owner names. Owner lookups are on the county's Real Property Search. Re-register if the county publishes a public parcel service again. History: down since 2026-08-04 (297 consecutive liveness failures), marked unreachable 2026-08-29, rechecked 2026-10-03 when the GreenvilleJS folder had been deleted. Candidates checked and rejected on 2026-10-03: the Greenville-Pickens transportation study's TaxParcel02172021_gdb FeatureServer (countywide with the county schema and owner search, but a February 2021 snapshot); the GreenvilleCountyBaseData FeatureServer by mwassonfigis (about 33,000 of about 228,000 parcels); the City of Greenville Parcels with Ownership layer on citygis.greenvillesc.gov (city jurisdiction only); a utility.arcgis.com proxy of the county's GCGIA feature service (inaccessible). Prior record (Greenville County, pop. 530,000, seat Greenville; verified 2026-05-15): Tax Parcel at layer index 52 of the Map_Layers_JS composite MapServer with PIN, OWNAM1/2, STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIP5, NAMECO, POWNNM, DEEDDATE, CUBOOK, CUPAGE, PLTBK1, PPAGE1, DIST, MKTAREA, JURIS, LANDUSE, DESCR and SUBDIV; SMITH returned Greenville SC addresses (e.g., '123 EXAMPLE AVE').

ownerFieldNote.body: Georgetown County's public parcel layer carries the TMS parcel number, plat reference and zoning only: no owner name, no site address and no mailing address. Search by TMS here. The county publishes owner and address attributes in a separate table with no parcel shapes (PARCELATTRIBUTES, keyed by the same TMS), which these tools cannot join to a parcel; look up an owner there by TMS, or ask the Georgetown County Assessor.

source.label: Georgetown County GIS & Asset Management Division

basis.note: The county's public Parcels layer (GCGIS_OpenData FeatureServer layer 2) has no owner-name column; owner names sit in a separate non-spatial PARCELATTRIBUTES table (layer 7) that has no geometry, so a location or radius lookup cannot reach them.
The county's public Parcels layer (GCGIS_OpenData FeatureServer layer 2) has no owner mailing-address column; mailing addresses sit only in the separate non-spatial PARCELATTRIBUTES table (layer 7).

The county's public Parcels layer (GCGIS_OpenData FeatureServer layer 2) has no site-address column, so a parcel cannot be found by street address here; the street number and name sit only in the separate non-spatial PARCELATTRIBUTES table (layer 7).

counties.notes: Georgetown County, South Carolina (Georgetown, Pawleys Island, Murrells Inlet; FIPS 45043) was asked for through the free tools. PARCEL SHAPES ONLY. The county's own Portal-hosted ArcGIS Server (gis1.georgetowncountysc.org, ArcGIS 11.2) publishes GCGIS_OpenData FeatureServer layer 2 ('Parcels'): 47,943 parcels on 2026-10-10, 47,942 with a TMS. Its only attribute columns are TMS (the tax map parcel number, formatted like 00-0000-000-00-00), PLAT and Zone; there is no owner, situs or mailing column. The layer's native spatial reference is wkid 3361 (South Carolina State Plane, feet), so request outSR=4326 for latitude/longitude. OWNER DATA EXISTS IN A SEPARATE TABLE that this record does not register: layer 7 of the same service, 'PARCELATTRIBUTES', is a non-spatial table (no geometry) with ParcelID and GisLookUpKey (both equal to the layer 2 TMS), YearID, StreetNumber and StreetName (the situs), Owner1 and Owner2, the mailing address BillingAddress/BillingAddress2/City/State/ZipCode, sale date and price, land-use code, land area and legal description. On 2026-10-10 it held 57,469 rows for YearID 2026 (57,468 with an owner) and 58 for 2025, so filter YearID=2026. It answers attribute queries (owner LIKE '%SMITH%' returned 831 rows) but cannot answer a location or radius query, and the atlas schema and its lookup, enrichment and radius tools query one spatial layer per endpoint with no join, so registering the table would advertise owner data those tools cannot deliver. Getting an owner for a parcel here takes two queries: the TMS from layer 2, then ParcelID = that TMS AND YearID = 2026 on layer 7. CORS: both layer 2 and table 7 echo the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination on both. Currency: layer 2's newest last_edited_date is 2026-06-24. The ArcGIS items on the Portal (558592e09870439d9f0477ed273b52e1 for the parcels, 2e895e71f27045c69b62d7bb8311146f for the table) returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-10, so no license or terms text was read; the service publishes none. The county's GIS & Asset Management Division handles addressing (843-545-3071) and the Assessor's Office maintains the property database. Verified 2026-10-10: a count, resultRecordCount=1 and a TMS LIKE query on layer 2, plus a count, resultRecordCount=1 and an owner LIKE query on table 7.

counties.notes: York County, South Carolina (county seat York; FIPS 45091) was searched on the site twice on 2026-10-28. The county GIS Division publishes its tax parcels with owner and mailing columns as the public hosted 'Parcels' feature service on the county's own ArcGIS Online organisation (York County, SC - GIS Online; item c27c00901daa4f0484c47a3719a8f03b), the layer listed on its Open Data hub (opendata-yorkcosc.hub.arcgis.com): 134,504 polygons on 2026-11-01, 134,489 with a non-blank Owner1. Condominium units are stacked polygons with their own TAXMAPID and the land parcel in ParentTaxID. The parcel id is TAXMAPID (134,497 rows); ParcelID and AprAccNum are alternative ids. The situs is PropertyAddress (125,557 rows). MAILING: MailAddr1 (133,880 rows), MailAddr2, MailApt, MailCity, MailState, MailZip. Values: AprTotVal (appraised), TaxTotVal, AsdTotVal; DateSold with SalePrice. Currency: the newest DateSold is 2026-10-29 (9,844 sales dated 2026, 2,065 since 2026-09-01) and the newest DATE_MODIFIED is 2026-10-29; the layer's dataLastEditDate is 2026-10-31. The layer has no placeholder for withheld owners (0 rows match CONFIDENTIAL, WITHHELD, REDACTED or RESTRICTED). NOT USED: HOMESTEAD (Y on 80,610 rows; it may reflect an age-, disability- or residence-based tax status, so it stays out), PreviousOwner (a second person's name). CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin * on the layer and every query. maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination; Web Mercator (wkid 102100). A point query with inSR 4326 north of the York courthouse returned one parcel on N Congress St; the point at the courthouse intersection itself falls in the street. OWNER DATA SERVED: on 2026-11-01 UrbanKit asked the county for written permission to use owner names and mailing addresses under S.C. Code 30-2-50, and on 2026-11-03 the county answered 'This data is open data for public use'. Owner1, Owner2 and the Mail columns are served, Owner1 and MailAddr1 are searchable, and the sample query is an owner search. The 30-2-50 notice travels as the capabilityOverrides basis on both owner roles. TERMS: the county's GIS Data Download page says the county provides GIS data 'at no cost' and offers 'a GeoService API to view individual data in your own application directly'; the item's licence is a no-warranty, not-a-legal-survey disclaimer; the hub has no terms page (its footer 'Terms of Service' link points nowhere). S.C. Code 30-2-50 makes it a misdemeanor to knowingly obtain or use personal information obtained from a state agency, a local government, or other political subdivision for commercial solicitation directed to any person in South Carolina. Verified 2026-11-01: a count, owner coverage, an owner LIKE query (1,385 rows for %SMITH%), a situs LIKE query (182 rows for %CONGRESS ST%) and a point query. Re-verified 2026-11-10: 134,515 polygons, Owner1 non-blank on 134,500, MailAddr1 on 133,894, and UPPER(Owner1) LIKE '%SMITH%' (the sample query's filter) 1,386 rows. The credit carries the 30-2-50 notice as of 2026-11-10, so it travels with every lookup, radius and enrich answer. Credit: York County, SC GIS (Open Data). counties.notes: Lancaster County, South Carolina (FIPS 45057) publishes a parcel layer with owner names and mailing addresses on its county ArcGIS Online organization. The layer's licence text, as of 2026-11-10, is an as-is disclaimer with no use restriction, but the county's GIS portal says it sells GIS digital data under its fee ordinance (Ordinance 2024-1924, sections 11.01 and 11.02), and South Carolina Code section 30-2-50 prohibits knowingly using personal information from local-government records 'for commercial solicitation directed to any person in this State' and requires the county to notify requestors. We have not asked the county. UrbanKit does not serve it without the county's permission. Lancaster County, South Carolina (45057) must not be confused with Lancaster County, Virginia (51103) or Lancaster County, Pennsylvania (42071). Search the county's own tools. Request this county with an email address and we will send you one email when we serve it.

coverage.summary: Lancaster County sells its GIS data by ordinance, and South Carolina bars using owner data from public records for commercial solicitation. We don't have the county's permission, so we don't index it. Request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
